title: Component variants and motion
description: variants.json: per component of catalogue.json, its style variants and its motion, and the packs each variant is built in. VariantsCoverageTest checks a built variant is in the pack's code and gallery.

kind.description: The catalogue's kind; its web styles are target-packs/components/styles/kinds/<kind>.css

wave.description: The wave of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md that refines and builds it

motion.description: Effect names from motion.json's effects (style follows the Component factory's motion choice); null for none

id.description: default is the component as drawn today; another id is the variant prop's value and the web class bx-v-<id>

name.description: Shown on the Component factory card

purpose.description: What it is for, in one line

source.description: own, or where a ported or inspired variant comes from (a URL)

licence.description: own, or the source's licence (MIT, Apache-2.0); never a licence that forbids ports

built.description: The packs it is built in

motion.description: The variant's own motion in words: on enter, hover, press and a value change (null where it adds none), and what shows under reduced motion
